2026 Primary Election

 
June 2, 2026
 Primary Election 
 

 The Primary Election is an election to determine which candidates will qualify for the General Election for a given party. In Iowa you must be a member of the political party of which you wish to vote for in order to participate. This is known as a "closed primary." The primary election is held on the 1st Tuesday following the 1st Monday in June of each even-numbered year.

Archived Election Details
 
Who?  
 

All Woodbury County voters 
 

What? 
 

The Primary Election is your opportunity to vote for the candidate that you would like to move forward to the November General Election. You may only vote in one party's primary. 
 

How? 
 

Absentee 
 

Beginning 3-24-2026, call 712-279-6465 to request your Absentee Ballot Request Form. 
 
 
 
Return your Absentee Ballot Request Form to the Auditor's Office by 5-18-2026. 
 
Ballots will be mailed beginning 5-13-2026. 
 
 

Note: Voted absentee ballots must be received in our office by 8:00 pm on Election Day (6-2-2026).  
 

Early In-Person Voting at the Auditor's Office 
 

Vote in person at the Woodbury County Auditor's Office. 
 
 
 
Wednesday, May 13, through Monday, June 1, 2026 | 8:00 am - 4:30 pm 
 
 
Saturday, May 30, voting closes earlier at 4:00 pm 
 
 
 
 

Election Day In-Person Voting at Your Polling Location 
 

Vote at your polling location on Election Day. 
 
 
 
Tuesday, June 2, 2026 | 7:00 am - 8:00 pm
